chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Ali al-Zayyat reported to me, he said: Ubaidullah ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn A'yan reported to us, he said: Mus'ar ibn Yahya al-Nahdi reported to us, he said: Sharik ibn Abdullah al-Qadhi reported to us, he said: Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani reported to us, from his father, from the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, said:
Three sins lead to immediate punishment and are not deferred until the Hereafter: disobedience to parents, tyranny over people, and ingratitude for kindness.

key_terms.البغي على الناس: Tyranny over people — unjust aggression, oppression, and transgression against others' rights
key_terms.تعجل عقوبتها: Their punishment is hastened — divine retribution occurs in this world rather than being reserved for the Hereafter
key_terms.عقوق الوالدين: Disobedience to parents — a major sin in Islam encompassing all forms of mistreatment and disrespect toward one's parents
key_terms.كفر الإحسان: Ingratitude for kindness — denying or failing to acknowledge favors and good deeds done by others

ai.seo_question: What are the three sins that are punished immediately according to Islamic teachings?
ai.summary: This Prophetic tradition, narrated through a chain reaching Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib from the Prophet Muhammad, identifies three sins whose punishment is not delayed until the Day of Judgment but manifests in this world. These sins are: mistreating one's parents, committing injustice against people, and being ungrateful for favors received. The hadith was originally taught in the context of emphasizing social responsibilities and interpersonal ethics, warning believers that certain transgressions carry immediate worldly consequences as a sign of their gravity.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Fahs Umar ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Zayyat reported to me from Ubaidullah ibn Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn A’ayan, who reported from Mas’ar ibn Yahya al-Nahdiy, who reported from Sharik ibn Abdillah al-Qadhi, who reported from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdaniy, from his father, from Amirul Mu’mineen, ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
"Three sins lead to immediate punishment and are not deferred till hereafter:- incurring displeasure of the parents, tyranny over the people, and denying the divine bounties (by abusing them)."
